name: Culling calendar
era: AC43 means After Culling 43 in the shared surviving historical reckoning. The end of a recognised major culling begins a new era; its first civil year is Year 1. Ordinary hunts and local raids do not reset the calendar. The numbered seasonal months continue; the next regular civil new year following the end of a major culling begins Year 1 of the new cycle. Dates during an unfinished culling remain in the existing cycle until its end is established.
maintenance: Advance only with story time. A new major culling resets the year count after its end; changing era must be explicit, with an old-to-new date bridge. Keep occurrence and report dates separate and preserve historic era labels.
notation: 67 AC43 = Year 67 after the 43rd recorded major culling; full dates are DD/MM/YYYY AC43. The elapsed phrase about 67 years is rounded historical usage, not a precise anniversary.
